retained_foundations.content: Finite-dimensional linear algebra, Riesz representation and Hilbert adjoints; finite-dimensional norm equivalence; number-field integral lattices, local integrality, different/codifferent definitions and Chinese remaindering; additive approximation in finite adeles; basic topological groups and Haar integration; Tonelli, Bochner integration and absolutely convergent series. Exact finite characters, the rational Levi, column stabilizers, support/return dictionaries and all changes of quotient domain are proved in the manuscript.

Arbitrary D7 and supplied HidaSetting X, and every Full X record Y, with original coefficient isomorphisms, global character, actual infinity and finite Haar measures, wave functions, finite-level transports, rows and splitting, column representatives, coset representatives, both unipotent domains, typed reduction and local models. This chapter does not construct X or Full or infer Forms0.

retained_foundations.status: exact named original premises retained in full
retained_foundations.content: For each supplied ordered pair of words: FoldOK and InHH for both words; FundExists, OOIntAll, OOFundIndep and AmpWellDef for the same original rows, flags and columns; AbsConvT with its full three clauses (summable operator norms, summable auxiliary vector norms and positive Gam1). Original all-vector, all-domain, all-carrier and all-representative quantifiers are unchanged. FoldOK supplies the pre-integration bound; AbsConvT is used only after unfolding for operator series. PuLinear alone uses just its original InHH premise.
